item.title: Ordered 20 times and still a new customer?… Coupang Eats stirs controversy over advertising fees for new customers targeting store owners (20번 주문해도 새 고객?…쿠팡이츠, 점주 대상 신규고객 광고비 ‘시끌’)
item.description:
A controversy has erupted over Coupang Eats' billing standards for new-customer advertisements. Some store owners listed on Coupang Eats claim that "repeat customers are being classified as new customers, resulting in additional advertising fees amounting to 5-10% of the food cost." While Coupang Eats maintains that this is merely a misunderstanding stemming from incorrect guidance by its customer service center, store owners counter that they were not informed of any policy changes and demand transparent disclosure of customer order histories, including order dates. (쿠팡이츠의 신규고객 광고 과금 기준을 두고 논란이 일고 있다. 쿠팡이츠에 입점한 일부 점주들이 ‘재주문고객까지 신규고객으로 분류돼 음식값의 5~10%에 이르는 광고 수수료를 추가로 부담했다’고 주장하면서다. 쿠팡이츠 쪽은 고객센터의 잘못된 안내에서 비롯된 오해일 뿐이라는 입장이지만, 점주들은 관련 정책이 바뀐 사실을 안내받지 못했다며 주문날짜 등 고객 주문 이력을 투명하게 공개하라고 맞서고 있다.)

According to a Hankyoreh report compiled on the 28th, store owner Mr. A recently confirmed that several customers who had placed orders at his store at least seven times, and up to twenty times, were counted as targets for new-customer advertisements. This information is indicated in the order records accessible to store owners. On the 27th, Mr. A inquired about this with the Coupang Eats customer service center and was reportedly told, "Customers who have not consented to the collection and use of personal information for marketing purposes are included as new customers." The customer service center explained that even consumers who have placed multiple orders are counted as new customers if they have not agreed to the collection and use of personal information. (28일 한겨레 취재를 종합하면, 점주 ㄱ씨는 최근 자신의 매장에서 최소 일곱 차례, 많게는 스무 차례 주문한 고객 여러명이 신규고객 광고 대상자로 집계된 사실을 확인했다. 이런 정보는 점주가 확인할 수 있는 주문 내역에 표시된다. 이에 ㄱ씨는 지난 27일 쿠팡이츠 고객센터에 관련 사안을 문의했고 “마케팅 목적의 개인정보 수집·이용에 동의하지 않은 고객은 신규고객에 포함된다”는 안내를 받았다고 한다. 여러차례 주문을 한 소비자라도 개인정보 수집·이용에 동의하지 않았다면 신규고객으로 집계된다는 것이 고객센터 설명이었다.)

Coupang Eats' advertisements are divided into categories targeting new customers, repeat customers, and all customers. Among these, the minimum commission rate for new-customer advertisements is 10%, double that of repeat-customer and all-customer advertisements (5%). While advertising is optional, store owners unanimously say they often choose new-customer ads, accepting the higher fees, to attract new clientele. Store owner Mr. B remarked, "If even regulars are classified as new customers, store owners' advertising cost burden inevitably becomes excessive." (쿠팡이츠 광고는 신규고객·재주문고객·전체고객 대상으로 나뉜다. 이 가운데 신규고객 광고의 최저 수수료율은 10%로, 재주문고객·전체고객 광고(5%)의 두 배다. 광고는 선택 사항이지만 점주들은 신규 고객 유치를 위해 높은 수수료를 감수하고 신규고객 광고를 선택하는 경우가 적지 않다고 입을 모은다. 점주 ㄴ씨는 “단골까지 신규고객으로 분류된다면 점주들의 광고비 부담이 지나치게 커질 수밖에 없다”고 말했다.)

This suspicion is amplified by its connection to a massive personal information breach at Coupang that occurred late last year. The incident is expected to result in a significant number of consumers not consenting to the use of their personal information on Coupang Eats. Store owner Mr. C stated, "If customers who did not consent to personal information usage were classified as new customers, store owners applying new-customer advertisements may have been bearing the high 10% fee even for orders from regulars." (이런 의혹은 지난해 말 발생한 쿠팡의 대규모 개인정보 유출 사고와도 맞물려 증폭된다. 해당 사고로 쿠팡이츠 개인정보 활용에 동의하지 않은 소비자가 적지 않을 것으로 예상되기 때문이다. 점주 ㄷ씨는 “개인정보 활용 미동의 고객들이 신규고객으로 분류됐다면, 신규고객 광고를 적용한 점주들은 단골손님의 주문에 대해서도 10%의 높은 수수료를 부담해왔을 가능성이 크다”고 말했다.)

In contrast, a Coupang Eats official said, "Currently, the standard for new customers in targeted advertising is applied based on the announced criteria (customers who have never ordered and those with no order history in the last 60 days), regardless of whether they consented to marketing communications," and added, "For stores that received incorrect guidance from the customer service center, the information has been corrected and re-communicated with the current standards." The official also stated, "We plan to strengthen related training for (customer service staff) to ensure accurate guidance is provided." (반면, 쿠팡이츠 관계자는 “현재 맞춤형 광고의 신규고객 기준은 마케팅 수신 동의 여부와 무관하게 안내된 기준(한 번도 주문하지 않은 고객과 최근 60일간 주문 이력이 없는 고객)으로 적용되고 있다”며 “고객센터에서 잘못 안내한 매장에는 (내용을) 정정하여 현재 기준을 재안내했다”고 밝혔다. 이어 “(고객센터를 대상으로) 관련 교육을 강화해 정확하게 안내될 수 있도록 할 예정”이라고 덧붙였다.)

However, the controversy shows no signs of subsiding easily. Store owners argue that while they can see the number of orders from a specific customer, they cannot verify the order dates, making it impossible to confirm whether Coupang Eats' explanation—such as the 60-day order history—is true. One store owner said, "Given that multiple customer service representatives provided the same information, it's hard to believe it was a mistake," and added, "Since advertising billing standards are directly tied to store owners' cost burdens, Coupang Eats should transparently disclose customer order dates and policy change details." (그러나 논란은 쉽게 가라앉지 않고 있다. 점주들은 특정 고객의 주문 횟수는 알 수 있지만 주문 날짜를 확인할 수 없어 60일간 주문 이력 등 쿠팡이츠 설명이 사실인지 검증할 방법이 없다고 주장한다. 한 점주는 “고객센터 상담사 여러 명이 동일한 내용을 안내한 만큼, 잘못 안내했다고 보기 어렵다”며 “광고 과금 기준은 점주의 비용 부담과 직결되는 만큼, 쿠팡이츠는 고객들의 주문 일자와 정책 변경 내역을 투명하게 공개해야 한다”고 말했다.)

Reporter Lee Joo-bin yes@hani.co.kr (이주빈 기자 yes@hani.co.kr)

item.title: [Exclusive] Government to Also Reduce Property Tax Deductions for Single-Home Owners... Considering a Cap of Within 10 Million Won ([단독] 1주택 종부세 세액공제도 줄인다…천만원 이내로 한도 검토)
item.description:
The government, which has effectively confirmed a tightening of property holding taxes, has been found to be actively considering a plan to set a cap at around 10 million won on the comprehensive real estate tax (CRET) deduction for single-home owners. The reason is that since the maximum deduction of 80% based on age and holding period has no limit, the higher the home price, the larger the tax cut, which undermines tax equity. (부동산 보유세 강화를 기정사실화한 정부가 1주택자의 종합부동산세(종부세) 세액공제에 1천만원 이내 수준의 한도를 설정하는 방안을 유력하게 검토하고 있는 것으로 확인됐다. 연령과 보유 기간에 따라 최대 80%까지 한도 없이 종부세를 깎아주다 보니, 집값이 비쌀수록 감세 규모가 커져 조세 형평에 어긋난단 이유에서다.)

A key government official told The Hankyoreh on the 28th, "We plan to introduce a new cap that does not exceed the typical level of tax deductions received by single-home owners with ultra-high-priced homes, which are often cited as 3 billion to 5 billion won in value." The government is set to announce a tax reform plan in early August that includes a property tax increase proposal. (정부 핵심 관계자는 28일 “초고가 주택으로 거론되는 30억~50억원(주택)을 보유한 1주택자들이 통상 받는 세액공제 규모를 넘지 않는 선에서 한도를 신설할 예정”이라고 한겨레에 말했다. 정부는 8월 초 보유세 인상안이 포함된 세제 개편안을 발표할 예정이다.)

Currently, CRET, which is imposed on owners of homes with a publicly announced price of 1.2 billion won or more, offers tax deductions if the owner is a single-home owner who has held the property for at least five years or is aged 60 or older. The deduction rate based on holding period is 20–50%, and based on age is 20–40%. Both deductions can be applied simultaneously up to a maximum of 80%, but there is no cap on the deduction amount. (현재 공시가격 12억원 이상 주택 보유자에게 부과되는 종부세는 1가구 1주택자이면서 보유 기간 5년 이상 또는 만 60살 이상이라는 조건을 충족하면 세액공제를 적용한다. 보유 기간에 따른 공제율은 20~50%, 연령에 따른 공제율은 20~40%다. 두 가지 공제를 80% 한도로 중복해 적용하는데, 공제 금액에 한도는 없다.)

Currently, a home valued at around 500 million won in market price, often cited as the upper limit for ultra-high-priced homes, would have a tax base of just over 1.4 billion won. The calculated tax would be 1.4 billion won multiplied by a tax rate of 1.3%, minus a progressive deduction of 6 million won, totaling 12.2 million won. Receiving the maximum deduction (80%) would reduce the tax by 9.76 million won, while just half (40%) would reduce it by 4.88 million won. If the government sets a 10 million won cap on the tax deduction, it means that among those holding homes valued at around 500 million won market price, the tax cut would be capped at a level similar to those who receive the maximum deduction. In this case, owners of ultra-high-priced homes exceeding a tax base of 1.4 billion won would face a higher tax burden than before. (현재 초고가 주택 기준의 상한으로 거론되는 시가 약 50억원 주택은 세 부과 기준의 근거가 되는 과세표준으로 환산하면 14억원 남짓이다. 이때 산출세액은 14억원에 세율 1.3%를 적용한 뒤 누진공제(600만원)를 뺀 1220만원이다. 여기서 세액공제를 최대(80%)로 받게 되면 976만원, 절반(40%)만 받는 경우엔 488만원의 세금이 감면된다. 정부가 1천만원 세액공제 한도를 설정하게 되면, 초고가 주택 기준으로 거론되는 시가 50억원 주택을 보유한 이들 가운데 최대한으로 공제를 받는 이들과 비슷한 수준까지만 세금을 깎아준다는 뜻이다. 이 경우 과표 14억원 선을 넘는 초고가 주택 보유자의 경우엔 기존보다 세 부담이 늘어나게 된다.)

However, for the elderly who would see their CRET burden increase under this reform, the government plans to ease the conditions for tax payment deferral, considering their ability to pay. Currently, taxpayers aged 60 or older or long-term owners with total annual salary of 70 million won or less, or comprehensive income of 60 million won or less, can defer payment until they transfer or inherit the property. The income criteria are expected to be further relaxed. (다만 이번 개편으로 종부세 부담이 커지게 되는 고령자의 경우엔 담세력을 고려해 납부유예 요건을 완화한다는 방침이다. 현재는 60살 이상 또는 장기보유자인 납세자의 총급여가 7천만원 이하 또는 종합소득금액이 6천만원 이하인 경우 납부를 양도 및 상속 등 처분 시기까지 미뤄주는데, 소득 기준을 보다 완화할 것으로 보인다.)

The government also plans to set a cap on the special long-term holding deduction for capital gains tax, similar to CRET. The special deduction currently applies a rate of up to 40% for both residence period and holding period, with a combined cap of 80%. A plan to abolish the deduction based on holding period to favor actual residency is being actively considered. Additionally, there is a critical view that deducting tens to hundreds of billions of won in taxes based on capital gains is excessive, so the government is considering capping the deduction amount at around the 1 billion won level. (정부는 양도소득세 장기보유특별공제(장특공제) 역시 종부세와 비슷하게 상한을 설정할 예정이다. 거주 기간과 보유 기간에 따라 각각 40%까지 공제율을 적용해 최대 80%까지 적용된 장특공제는 실거주 우대를 위해 보유 기간에 따른 공제는 폐지하는 방안이 유력하게 검토되고 있다. 또 양도차익에 따라 수십억~수백억원에 이르는 세금을 깎아주는 것은 과도하다는 문제의식 아래 공제 금액도 10억원대 수준으로 한도를 두는 방안을 검토 중이다.)

Reporter Park Su-ji suji@hani.co.kr (박수지 기자 suji@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Economy and Society Trapped in the 'Samsung-SK Hynix Black Hole'... Warnings Grow Louder (‘삼전닉스 블랙홀’에 갇힌 경제·사회…경고음 커진다)
item.description:
On July 20, a small meeting room at the National Assembly Members' Office Building hosted a forum on Samsung affiliates funneling 2.78 trillion won worth of in-house meal service contracts to its affiliate Samsung Welstory over eight years. From 2013 to 2021, four affiliates—Samsung Electronics, Samsung Display, Samsung Electro-Mechanics, and Samsung SDI—awarded 100% of their in-house meal services to Welstory through private contracts without competitive bidding. The Fair Trade Commission deemed this unfair support and imposed a 234.9 billion won fine. However, on April 23, the Seoul High Court fully overturned this order. <<> The issue lies in the logic of the ruling. The court determined that to prove this support was illegal, it must be directly documented that Samsung Electronics and others had the "intent" to preserve Welstory's profits. Documents from the Future Strategy Office were presented, and there were circumstances where competitive bidding was suddenly halted entirely. Emails instructing Welstory employees to delete documents containing keywords like "chairman, chairman, Future Strategy Office, contract favoritism, profit margin preservation" also emerged. Yet the court dismissed each one, arguing that none constituted "direct evidence explicitly stating support intent." The court demanded "proof far stricter than criminal verdicts" in an administrative sanction case. Rather than judging by synthesizing circumstances and circumstantial evidence, it demolished each piece of evidence one by one, with a "this doesn't count, that doesn't count" approach. Under such a method, the very means to prove unfair support between affiliates—which by nature leaves no paper trail—disappears. The system meant to check giant corporations was neutralized before their defense arguments. <<> Yet the venue covering that news was empty. The world's attention was elsewhere. On May 27, 16 single-stock leveraged products were simultaneously listed on the domestic stock market. These were products tracking Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix stock prices at twice the daily fluctuation rate. On the first day of listing alone, trading volume exceeded 10 trillion won. Individual investors' net purchases surpassed 2 trillion won. Applications for mandatory pre-trading education surged, temporarily crashing the Korea Financial Investment Association's website. Over June, trading in leveraged products for the two companies reached 212 trillion won. Retirees' nest eggs, young people's seed money, and even minors with parental consent jumped in. Two scenes surrounding the same company diverged so starkly. These days, the media increasingly uses the term "Samjeonnikseu." This new coinage, merging Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix into one, carries serious social meaning. It signifies that, fueled by the AI semiconductor boom, the two companies are sucking in all of Korea's economic and social attention, capital, and even policy. Welstory and leveraged products are contrasting scenes. Placing them side by side reveals what happens across society when a giant corporation's influence crosses a critical threshold. <<> Conflict Intensifies Between Unions and Shareholders Over Giant Corp. Operating Profits <<> Conflicts of interest over the enormous profits of giant corporations have also persisted. In April, a Samsung Electronics union held a rally of 40,000 people at the Pyeongtaek campus. They demanded performance bonuses equivalent to 15% of operating profit. Across the way, the "Korea Shareholder Action Group" held a counter-rally, likening the union's demands to "vicious creditors." In May, People's Solidarity for Participatory Democracy prepared a forum to discuss how to distribute semiconductor excess profits among workers, subcontractors, and society. But a post on an online bulletin board, mixing threats to "kill" forum attendees with regional hate speech, prompted a police response. In May, labor and management tentatively agreed to create a special performance bonus for the semiconductor (DS) division, using about 12% of business performance as a fund. The shareholder action group immediately threatened a lawsuit. On the 22nd, they actually filed a complaint with the National Investigation Headquarters of the National Police Agency against the CEOs of Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix on charges of breach of trust under the Act on the Aggravated Punishment of Specific Economic Crimes. Even Minister of Employment and Labor Kim Young-hoon, who mediated the negotiation, was jointly reported to the Corruption Investigation Office for High-ranking Officials on charges of abuse of authority. The hard-won labor-management agreement returned as a criminal complaint. In July, the government announced a 400 trillion won "Honam Semiconductor Mega Project." In response, a super-enterprise union declared it would make this a 2027 wage and collective bargaining agenda item, citing 84% opposition in an internal survey. <<> Shareholder groups and unions each present plausible arguments. But the fundamental reason issues that once fell within the realm of agreement and discretion have recently been escalated to lawsuits, death threats, and hatred is different. It's because the total pie to be divided has grown. Moreover, systems for excess profits have a long history. It's not as if a communist system was suddenly introduced recently. Samsung Electronics introduced a "PS" (Profit Sharing) system in 2001. It involved distributing up to 20% of excess profit to employees when a business unit exceeded its targets. In 2014, it was renamed "OPI" (Over achievement Profit Incentive) and continues to this day. The "profit" here refers to Economic Value Added (EVA), which is operating profit after tax minus capital costs. If this EVA exceeds the target set at the beginning of the year, 20% of the excess becomes the fund. An individual can receive up to 50% of their annual salary. <<> Given this history, the current conflict is not a problem with the system itself. It's a sign that the practice of negotiation and compromise surrounding that system has collapsed. That domain is now being entirely transferred to the desks of prosecutors and police. When negotiations break down, lawsuits are filed; policies not liked are labeled abuse of authority. This is a familiar scene. The political sphere has voluntarily abandoned its ability to find answers in the National Assembly. Instead, it tries to settle scores through accusations and complaints. It closely mirrors the so-called judicialization of politics. This attitude of habitually kicking problems that should be resolved by agreement into the judicial domain is itself evidence that internal conflicts within giant corporations are replicating the old pathologies of Korean politics. It shows that internal stakeholders dislike each other that much. <<> Samjeonnikseu Growth Erodes Other Sectors... Risk of 'Dutch Disease' <<> A recent report stated that while real GDP in the first quarter of this year increased by 3.8% year-on-year, real GDI surged by 13.2%, widening the gap between the two indicators to 9.4 percentage points. It attributed this to the fact that semiconductor prices jumped 92.5% in one year, with semiconductors alone accounting for 73.4% of the total increase in export prices. The diagnosis is that the structural demand expansion driven by AI could prolong the boom. However, it also noted that the warmth of this boom is not spreading evenly. Capital expenditure by Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix alone is projected to expand from 75 trillion won last year to 120 trillion won this year and 150 trillion won next year. In contrast, investment in other sectors excluding semiconductors remains sluggish due to the lingering impact of poor industry performance and high oil prices. Most of the increase in listed companies' operating profits is also concentrated in these two companies. It warned that if this concentration persists, the economy could fall into so-called Dutch Disease—a phenomenon where "high wages and investment returns in a specific sector absorb labor and investment from other sectors, eroding the growth base." Moreover, the domestic semiconductor industry relies on imports for 60% of its manufacturing equipment. Foreign direct investment by the two companies is also increasing. The channels through which the massive money they earn flows into other domestic industries are narrowing. The income and assets swollen by the semiconductor super-boom are concentrated in the IT sector and high-income, high-asset groups. As money flows to groups with low consumption propensity, the domestic demand spillover effect is limited. Investment in non-IT sectors remains sluggish. Two risks were also warned: one is the risk that funds flowing in from the semiconductor boom could flow into real estate rather than productive investment, exacerbating financial imbalances. The other is a mid-to-long-term concern that an excessive concentration of production factors like labor and capital in the IT sector could lead to "the collapse of ecosystems in other key industries and deepening inter-class imbalances." <<> Court Disables Checks, Unions-Shareholders Fracture, Financial Sector Amplifies Volatility <<> The side effects when a giant corporation sucks in all attention and resources like a black hole can be broadly categorized into three. First, the neutralization of checks. The Welstory ruling set a precedent. The Fair Trade Commission is now effectively required to meet "prosecution-grade evidence" when reviewing internal transactions of large corporations. Amid the Samjeonnikseu frenzy, 1.16 million people completed education for leveraged trading. Meanwhile, the forum examining the implications of this ruling received no attention. The moment a monitoring system is disabled arrives quietly when no one is watching. Second, the brutalization of conflict resolution. The conflict over performance bonuses returned not as dialogue but as a lawsuit. The forum intended to discuss distributing excess profits was met not with logical rebuttals but with death threats. Instead of talking to each other, stakeholders try to overpower each other with force and threats. This itself shows how acute and swollen the interests surrounding giant corporations have become. Third, the amplification of volatility due to concentration. Half of the KOSPI's market capitalization is concentrated in two stocks. With leveraged funds added, KOSPI volatility roughly doubled compared to before the listing of leveraged products. The warning about "Dutch Disease," where the national economy's growth base itself is skewed toward a specific sector, stems from the same root. The more resources are concentrated in one place, the more the entire system is shaken by even a small shock. This is because all the eggs are in one basket. A more serious problem is that different actors are involved in each of these three side effects. The court's ruling neutralized the checks; unions and shareholder groups turned conflict into violence; and the financial sector amplified volatility. As long as the actors creating the problems are so dispersed, the government alone cannot stop this black hole. <<> Professor Lee Chang-min (Business Administration, Hanyang University) (지난 7월20일 국회의원회관 작은 간담회실. 삼성 계열사들이 8년간 2조7800억원어치 사내급식 물량을 계열사인 삼성웰스토리에 몰아준 사건을 다루는 토론회가 열렸다. 2013년부터 2021년까지 삼성전자·삼성디스플레이·삼성전기·삼성SDI 네 계열사는 사내급식 100%를 경쟁입찰 없이 수의계약으로 웰스토리에 맡겼다. 공정거래위원회는 이를 부당지원행위로 판단해 2349억원의 과징금을 부과했다. 그런데 지난 4월23일 서울고법은 이 처분을 전부 취소했다.)

item.title: "Focus on Outside Directors and Communicate in the Language of Minority Shareholders" (“사외이사에 초점 맞추고 소수주주의 언어로 소통해라”)
item.description:
<<>> Korea's Stewardship Code, introduced in 2016, has been revised for the first time in a decade since its enactment and is set to take effect next January. This code, which calls on institutional investors to act like stewards—monitoring investee companies and demanding improvements—has been effectively dormant over the past ten years. Questions loom over each issue ahead of the actual implementation of the revised code: whether the National Pension Service will transfer voting rights when entrusting assets to commissioned asset managers, how to resolve conflicts of interest among asset managers affiliated with conglomerates or financial groups, and whether there is a way for individual institutions with limited power to raise their voices collectively. ()

On the 22nd of last month, we met Bruce Duguid, Head of Stewardship at EOS, in London. EOS is the stewardship specialist arm of the global asset manager Federated Hermes. Acting on behalf of asset owners such as pension funds, insurers, and foundations, EOS monitors companies, engages in dialogue, and executes voting rights—essentially, it is the pioneer of 'shareholder rights agency.' Out of a total of about 45 staff, 30 professionals handle 450 to 500 companies annually. In 2025 alone, they engaged with 859 companies on 3,849 issues and objectives, and executed clients' voting rights at 13,516 shareholder meetings. The assets under management of the institutions they advise amount to $2.4 trillion (approximately 3,300 trillion won). After an in-person interview with Duguid, we received additional written responses on issues related to Korea. The key takeaways from the interview can be summarized into three main points. (2016년 도입된 한국 스튜어드십 코드가 제정 10년 만에 처음으로 개정돼, 내년 1월부터 적용을 앞두고 있다. 기관투자자가 ‘집사’(스튜어드)처럼 투자 대상 기업을 살피고 개선을 요구하도록 하자는 이 규범은, 지난 10년간 사실상 잠들어 있었다는 평가를 받는다. 국민연금이 위탁운용사에 자산을 맡기면서 의결권까지 넘길지, 재벌·금융그룹 계열 운용사의 이해상충은 어떻게 풀지, 개별 기관의 힘이 부칠 때 함께 목소리를 낼 길은 있는지. 개정안의 실제 적용에 앞서 쟁점마다 이런 물음표가 붙어 있다.)

( 지난달 22일 영국 런던의 이오에스(EOS) 사무실에서 스튜어드십 책임자 브루스 듀기드를 만났다. 이오에스는 글로벌 자산운용사 페더레이티드 허미스의 스튜어드십 전문 조직으로, 연기금·보험사·재단 같은 자산소유자를 대신해 기업을 관찰하고 대화하며 의결권 행사를 집행하는, 말하자면 ‘주주권 대행’의 원조 격인 기관이다. 전체 인원 약 45명 가운데 30명의 전문인력이 연간 450~500개 기업을 상대한다. 2025년 한 해 859개 기업과 3849건의 이슈·목표를 놓고 대화했고,1만3516회의 주주총회에서 고객의 의결권 행사를 집행했다. 자문하는 기관의 운용자산은 2조4천억달러(약 3300조원)에 이른다. 듀기드와 대면 인터뷰를 한 뒤, 한국 관련 쟁점에 대해서는 서면으로 추가 답변을 받았다. 인터뷰에서 확인한 시사점은 크게 세 가지다.)

First, 'culture is more important than the code.' When asked what single change Korean institutional investors need most, Duguid pointed to people, not regulations. "Regulatory reforms and code revisions only provide the necessary framework. Whether stewardship becomes meaningful will depend on the behavioral changes of domestic institutional investors and the leading domestic funds that drive such changes." No matter how sophisticated the code, if institutional investors don't act on their own, it remains mere paper. This is a painful diagnosis for Korea, where the code has been dormant for a decade. ()

Second, there are ways to engage even with companies that have controlling shareholders, such as founding families. Duguid stated that engaging with large Korean companies, where control is concentrated in the hands of the founding family, requires a "fundamentally different approach." Since the board and management often tend to represent the interests of the controlling shareholder, he advised focusing engagement on outside directors and framing agendas in the "language of minority shareholders"—issues like board effectiveness, impact on corporate valuation, and capital cost matters such as share buybacks and cancellations. Instead of vague calls to "improve governance," he recommended speaking in terms of numbers and stock prices. He also noted that Korean regulations limiting directors' outside board memberships narrow the pool of candidates, but positively assessed the recent trend among large corporations to recruit foreign directors despite language barriers. (첫째, ‘코드보다 문화’가 더 중요하다는 점이다. 한국 기관투자자에게 필요한 단 하나의 변화를 묻자 듀기드는 규정이 아니라 사람을 짚었다. “규제 개혁과 코드 개정은 필요한 틀을 제공할 뿐이다. 스튜어드십이 실제로 의미를 가질지는 국내 기관투자자들의 행동 변화, 그리고 그것을 이끄는 선도적 국내 펀드에 달려 있다.” 아무리 정교한 코드를 만들어도 기관투자자 스스로 움직이지 않으면 종이 위의 규범에 그친다는 얘기다. 10년간 코드가 잠들어 있던 한국에겐 뼈아픈 진단이다.)

Third, if it's tough alone, band together; if you lack the strength to unite, borrow it. Duguid believes that a collective engagement model "can work in Korea as well." Pooling the influence of multiple investors can overcome the structural limitations of individual engagement, and he cited Japan's recent revision of its stewardship code, which explicitly encourages collaborative engagement, as a valid precedent for Korea. He particularly noted that "participation by institutions like the National Pension Service enhances legitimacy and influence." The following is the Q&A with Duguid. ( 둘째, 창업자 일가 등 지배주주가 있는 기업에도 공략법은 있다는 것이다. 듀기드는 지배력이 총수 일가에 집중된 한국 대기업에 관여할 때는 “근본적으로 다른 접근”이 필요하다고 말했다. 이사회와 경영진이 지배주주의 이익을 대변하기 쉬운 구조이므로, 관여의 초점을 사외이사에 맞추고, 의제를 ‘소수주주의 언어’—이사회 실효성, 기업가치(밸류에이션)에 미치는 영향, 자사주 소각 같은 자본비용 문제—로 짜라는 것이다. 막연히 ‘지배구조를 개선하라’가 아니라 숫자와 주가로 말하라는 조언이다. 그는 이사의 겸직을 제한하는 한국 규제로 이사 후보군이 좁다는 점도 짚으며, 최근 대기업들이 언어 장벽에도 불구하고 외국인 이사 영입에 나서기 시작한 변화를 긍정적으로 평가했다.)

— Korea introduced its Stewardship Code in 2016, but it has been criticized as effectively nominal for the past decade. Now, the government and political circles are overhauling the code to encourage active implementation by institutional investors. If you had to pick one most important change for Korean institutional investors to engage effectively? ( 셋째, 혼자 힘들면 뭉치고, 뭉칠 힘이 없으면 빌리라는 것이다. 듀기드는 집단적 관여 모델이 “한국에서도 작동할 수 있다”고 봤다. 여러 투자자의 영향력을 한데 모으면 개별 관여의 구조적 한계를 넘어설 수 있고, 일본이 최근 스튜어드십 개정에서 협력적 관여를 명시적으로 장려한 것이 한국에 유효한 선례라는 것이다. 특히 그는 “국민연금 같은 기관의 참여가 정당성과 영향력을 강화한다”고 했다. 다음은 듀기드와의 일문일답이다. )

"Code reform is important, but the most critical change is the establishment of a genuine stewardship culture among domestic institutional investors. Regulatory reforms and revised codes can only provide the necessary framework. Whether stewardship becomes truly meaningful will ultimately depend on changes in the behavior of institutional investors, backed by leading domestic funds." ( — 한국은 2016년 스튜어드십 코드를 도입했지만 지난 10년간 사실상 유명무실했다는 평가가 있다. 이제 정부와 정치권이 코드를 전면 손질해 기관투자자의 적극적 이행을 유도하려 한다. 한국 기관투자자가 효과적으로 관여하기 위해 가장 중요한 변화 하나를 꼽는다면?)

— Korea has a unique governance structure called 'chaebol,' where founding families control multiple affiliates as controlling shareholders. Minority shareholder rights are often not properly protected, and institutional investor engagement is frequently ineffective. What engagement strategies are appropriate for such companies? ( “코드 개혁도 중요하지만, 가장 결정적인 변화는 국내 기관투자자들 사이에 진정한 스튜어드십 문화가 형성되는 것이다. 규제 개혁과 개정된 코드는 필요한 틀을 제공할 수 있을 뿐이다. 스튜어드십이 실제로 의미 있는 것이 될지는 결국 선도적인 국내 펀드들이 뒷받침하는 기관투자자들의 행동 변화에 달려 있다.”)

"Engaging with chaebols requires a fundamentally different approach from standard governance engagement. This is because control is highly concentrated in the founding family, often maintained through complex cross-shareholding structures. In practice, the board and management tend to reflect the interests of the controlling shareholder rather than acting as independent stewards for all shareholders. Therefore, we focus our engagement on the board's outside (independent) directors and frame the agenda in a language that resonates with minority shareholders. ( — 한국에는 창업주 일가가 지배주주로서 여러 계열사를 지배하는 ‘재벌’이라는 독특한 지배구조가 있다. 소수주주 권리가 제대로 보호되지 않고 기관투자자의 관여도 효과를 내기 어려운 경우가 많다. 이런 기업에는 어떤 관여 전략이 적절한가?)

That includes board effectiveness, impact on corporate value, capital cost issues like share buybacks and cancellations, and minority shareholder perceptions. Beyond the chaebol ownership structure, Korea also faces issues arising from board composition. Regulations limiting directors from serving on more than two boards narrow the pool of candidates, and many companies have been hesitant to recruit foreign directors due to language barriers and the requirement for in-person board attendance. However, recently, there has been a movement, especially among large corporations, to expand the talent pool across borders despite these constraints." ( “재벌 관여에는 표준적인 지배구조 관여와는 근본적으로 다른 접근이 필요하다. 지배력이 창업주 일가에 고도로 집중돼 있고, 흔히 복잡한 순환출자 구조를 통해 유지되기 때문이다. 실제로 이사회와 경영진은 모든 주주의 독립적인 관리인이라기보다 지배주주의 이익을 반영하는 경향이 있다. 그래서 우리는 관여의 초점을 이사회의 사외이사(독립이사)에 맞추고, 의제를 소수주주에게 와닿는 언어로 구성한다. )

— Do you think a collective and collaborative engagement model can work in Korea? ( 이사회 실효성, 기업가치에 미치는 영향, 자사주 소각 같은 자본비용 문제, 소수주주의 인식 등이다. 한국에는 재벌 소유구조 외에 이사회 구성에서 비롯되는 문제도 있다. 한 이사가 두 개를 초과하는 이사회에서 일할 수 없도록 하는 규제 탓에 이사 후보군이 좁고, 언어 장벽과 이사회 대면 참석 문제 등으로 외국인 이사 영입에 소극적이던 기업들이 많았다. 하지만 최근에는 대기업을 중심으로 이런 제약에도 불구하고 국경 너머로 인재풀을 넓히려는 움직임이 나타나고 있다.”)

"It can work. However, adjustments are needed to fit the environment where controlling shareholders dominate the market. Pooling the influence of investors enhances the credibility of engagement and helps overcome the structural limitations of individual efforts. Recent trends in Asia support this. Japan explicitly encouraged a collaborative engagement model in its latest stewardship revision, recognizing its effectiveness in addressing governance and broader market issues. This is a valid precedent for Korea, which faces similar structural challenges. In practice, collaboration is most effective when focused on specific, high-impact issues such as capital allocation, related-party transactions, and governance reform and effectiveness. It's important for both global and domestic investors to participate together, and participation by institutions like the National Pension Service enhances legitimacy and influence." ( ― 집단적·협력적 관여 모델이 한국에서도 작동할 수 있다고 보나?)

— Korea's National Pension Service retains voting rights even when it entrusts assets to commissioned asset managers. In the EOS structure, who holds the ultimate voting right? ( “작동할 수 있다. 다만 지배주주가 시장을 지배하는 환경에 맞게 조정이 필요하다. 투자자들의 영향력을 한데 모으면 관여의 신뢰도를 높이고 개별 관여의 구조적 한계를 극복하는 데 도움이 된다. 최근 아시아의 흐름도 이를 뒷받침한다. 일본은 최신 스튜어드십 개정에서 협력적 관여 모델을 명시적으로 장려했다. 지배구조와 시장 전반의 문제를 다루는 데 효과적이라고 인정한 것이다. 비슷한 구조적 과제를 안고 있는 한국에 유효한 선례다. 실제 협력은 자본 배분, 특수관계자 거래, 지배구조 개혁과 실효성 같은 구체적이고 파급력 큰 이슈에 집중할 때 가장 효과적이다. 글로벌 투자자와 국내 투자자가 함께 참여하는 것이 중요한데, 국민연금 같은 기관의 참여는 정당성과 영향력을 강화한다.”)

"The client retains the shareholder rights and delegates the execution of policy to us. This means that even when assets are entrusted to asset managers, the authority to exercise voting rights is withdrawn from the manager and transferred to EOS. However, the delegation is only about execution; the final decision-making power rests with the client, the asset owner." ( ― 한국 국민연금은 위탁운용사에 자산을 맡겨도 의결권은 직접 보유한다. 이오에스 구조에서 최종적인 의결권은 누가 갖는가?)

— Why do asset owners outsource engagement activities to EOS rather than doing it themselves? ( “고객이 주주권을 보유하고 우리에게 정책 집행을 위임하는 구조다. 자산을 운용사에 위탁한 경우에도 의결권 행사 권한을 운용사에서 회수해 이오에스로 이전한다는 의미다. 그러나 위임은 어디까지나 집행에 관한 것이고, 최종 결정권은 자산소유자인 고객이 갖는다.”)

"EOS is both the stewardship team of Federated Hermes and a provider of stewardship services to third-party clients. Most of our clients are asset owners like pension funds, insurers, and foundations, rather than asset managers. Asset owners have a much longer time horizon for their assets and need to manage systemic risks that are difficult to diversify through active management alone. If asset owners built their own teams, resource constraints would limit them to dealing with only a handful of companies. Our 30 professionals handle 450 to 500 companies annually, covering about 50% of the portfolio value of a large asset owner. We can maintain high-quality relationships with companies and directly meet with senior executives. It's a matter of efficiency and effectiveness." ( ― 자산소유자들이 관여 활동을 직접 하지 않고 이오에스에 아웃소싱하는 이유는 무엇인가?)

— How do you measure the performance of engagement activities? What defines a successful engagement? ( “이오에스는 페더레이티드 허미스의 스튜어드십 팀인 동시에 제3의 고객을 위한 스튜어드십 서비스 제공자다. 고객 대부분은 자산운용사가 아닌 연기금·보험사·재단 같은 자산소유자다. 자산소유자는 운용사보다 훨씬 긴 시간 지평으로 자산을 바라보고, 능동적 운용만으로는 분산하기 어려운 시스템적 리스크를 관리해야 한다. 자산소유자가 자체 팀을 꾸리면 리소스 한계로 극소수 기업밖에 다룰 수 없다. 우리는 30명의 전문인력으로 연간 450~500개 기업을 담당하는데, 이는 대형 자산소유자 포트폴리오 가치의 약 50%에 해당한다. 기업과 질 높은 관계를 유지하며 고위 임원들과 직접 면담할 수 있다. 효율성과 효과성의 문제다.”)

"We always set specific goals before starting an engagement. There are four milestones on the journey toward the goal. Stage 1 is raising concerns with the company, Stage 2 is the company recognizing and understanding the issue, Stage 3 is the company expressing a willingness to change, and Stage 4 is the company actually implementing the change. Once the engagement is completed, we write a case study and calculate the future impact of the change. A typical engagement takes about three years, but it can end in one to two years or last six to seven years. We track progress using 'momentum indicators.' If it's too slow, we may decide to discontinue the engagement." ( ― 관여 활동의 성과는 어떻게 측정하나? 성공적인 관여의 정의는 무엇인가?)

— What criteria do you use to select companies for engagement? ( “우리는 항상 구체적인 목표를 설정하고 관여를 시작한다. 목표를 향한 여정에 4단계 마일스톤이 있다. 1단계는 기업에 우려를 제기하는 것, 2단계는 기업이 문제를 인식하고 이해하는 것, 3단계는 기업이 변화 의지를 표명하는 것, 4단계는 기업이 실제로 변화를 실행하는 것이다. 관여가 완료되면 케이스스터디를 작성하고 그 변화가 미래에 가져올 효과도 계산한다. 일반적인 관여는 약 3년이 걸리지만 1~2년에 끝나기도, 6~7년 지속되기도 한다. ‘모멘텀 지표'로 진행 속도를 추적해, 너무 더디면 관여 중단을 결정하기도 한다.”)

"There are three criteria. First is the size of the client's stake—the financial interest. Second is the materiality of the issue itself at the company. We look at which sector it belongs to and how significant the systemic challenge is. Third is the feasibility of actually creating change. This includes whether shareholder rights are well-protected, whether there is a controlling shareholder making discussions difficult, or if it's a state-owned enterprise. After synthesizing these three elements, we analyze the financial materiality of each company's issues using our patented 'financial connectivity' platform. We partially use artificial intelligence (AI), but our team makes the judgment on the specific context of each company." ( ― 관여할 기업은 어떤 기준으로 선정하나?)

— If an engagement is not going well, how do you escalate pressure? ( “세 가지 기준이 있다. 첫째는 고객의 보유 지분, 즉 재무적 이해관계의 크기다. 둘째는 해당 기업에서 이슈 자체의 중요성이다. 어떤 섹터에 속해 있고 시스템적 도전이 얼마나 큰지 본다. 셋째는 실제로 변화를 만들어낼 수 있는 가능성(feasibility)이다. 주주권이 잘 보장돼 있는지, 지배주주가 있어 논의가 어렵거나 국영기업은 아닌지 등이다. 이 세 요소를 종합한 뒤 우리가 특허를 보유한 ‘금융연계성'(financial connectivity) 플랫폼으로 각 기업의 이슈별 재무적 중요성을 분석한다. 인공지능(AI)도 일부 활용하지만, 각 기업의 구체적 맥락에 대한 판단은 우리 팀이 직접 한다.”)

"The foundation is a constructive relationship with the company. We are on the same side and want the same thing. But if there's no progress, we escalate gradually. First, we intensify meetings. We increase the frequency and contact board members—especially outside directors—directly, rather than just the IR team. Second, we use voting rights. We signal concerns by opposing the re-election of directors, for example. Third, we use shareholder resolutions. In practice, it's the client (shareholder) who proposes the resolution, and we support it. Fourth, though rare, we take the issue public through the media. If even then engagement is fundamentally impossible, it might be a company where engagement isn't viable. In that case, we deprioritize the allocation of resources or discontinue the engagement." ( ― 관여가 잘 진행되지 않으면 어떻게 압박 수위를 높이나?)

— There is strong backlash against ESG in the U.S. In Korea, there are concerns that overemphasizing environmental (E) and social (S) factors could overshadow the more urgent governance (G) issues. Is there a priority among these elements? ( “기본은 기업과의 건설적인 관계다. 우리는 같은 편에 있고 같은 것을 원한다. 그래도 진전이 없으면 단계적으로 강도를 높인다. 첫째, 면담을 강화한다. 빈도를 늘리고 아이아르(IR)팀이 아닌 이사회 멤버, 특히 사외이사와 직접 접촉한다. 둘째, 의결권 행사다. 이사 재선임 반대 등으로 우려의 신호를 보낸다. 셋째, 주주결의안이다. 실제로는 고객(주주)이 제안을 발의하고 우리가 지원하는 방식이다. 넷째, 드물지만 언론을 통해 이슈를 공론화한다. 그래도 접근이 근본적으로 불가능하다면 그 기업은 관여할 수 없는 곳일 수 있다. 그럴 땐 자원 배분의 우선순위를 낮추거나 관여를 중단한다.”)

"We see governance as a 'horizontal foundation' on which all other issues rest. Only when proper governance is established can long-term strategy formulation, capital allocation, and even the identification of environmental and social risks be done properly. While new issues like biodiversity and responsible AI are emerging, governance remains at the core of managing all these issues well." ( ― 미국에서는 ESG 반발이 거세다. 한국에서도 환경(E)·사회(S)를 과도하게 강조하면 정작 시급한 지배구조(G) 문제가 가려진다는 지적이 있다. 세 요소에 우선순위가 있나?)

London/ Text and photo by Lee Bong-hyun, ESG Center Research Fellow, Hankyoreh Economic and Social Research Institute bhlee@hani.co.kr ( “지배구조는 다른 모든 이슈의 기반이 되는 ‘수평적 토대’라고 본다. 올바른 지배구조가 확립돼야 장기 전략 수립과 자본 배분은 물론, 환경·사회적 리스크를 식별하는 일까지 제대로 할 수 있다. 생물다양성이나 책임 있는 인공지능 같은 새 이슈가 부상하고 있지만, 이 모든 이슈를 잘 관리하는 중심에는 여전히 지배구조가 있다.”)

item.title: As of end of last year, individual landowners reached 20.12 million, accounting for 39.4% of total population (지난해 말 기준 개인 토지 소유자 2012만명…전체 인구 중 39.4%)
item.description:
As of the end of last year, the number of individual landowners stood at 20.12 million, up 2.4% from a year earlier. (지난해 말 기준 개인 토지 소유자가 2012만명으로 1년 전보다 2.4% 늘었다.)

According to the land ownership statistics as of the end of 2025 released by the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport on the 29th, among the registered population of 51.12 million, 20.12 million (39.4%) were landowners. This represents an increase of 470,000 people (2.4%) compared to 2024. The total owned area was 46,127 km2 (45.9%), down 131 km2 (0.3%) from a year earlier. ( 29일 국토교통부가 발표한 2025년 말 기준 토지소유현황 통계를 보면, 주민등록인구 5112만명 가운데 토지 소유자는 2012만명(39.4%)인 것으로 나타났다. 이는 2024년과 견줘 47만명(2.4%) 늘어난 수치다. 소유 면적은 4만6127㎢(45.9%)로 1년 전보다 131㎢(0.3%) 감소했다.)

Among the 24.3 million registered households, the number of land-owning households increased by 350,000 (2.3%) from a year earlier to 15.65 million. The average owned area per household was 2,947 m2, down 76 m2 (2.5%) from a year earlier. ( 주민등록 2430만 가구 가운데 토지소유 가구 수는 1년 전보다 35만 가구(2.3%) 늘어난 1565만 가구로 나타났다. 가구별 평균 소유 면적은 2947㎡로 1년 전보다 76㎡(2.5%) 감소했다.)

By age group, those in their 60s owned the largest area at 13,860 km2 (30%), followed by those in their 70s at 10,141 km2 (22%) and those in their 50s at 9,443 km2 (20.5%). The gender ratio of landowners was 54.3% male and 45.7% female. ( 연령별로는 60대의 소유면적이 1만3860㎢(30%)로 가장 많았다. 70대는 1만141㎢(22%), 50대는 9443㎢(20.5%)를 소유했다. 성별 토지소유자 수 비율은 남성이 54.3%, 여성이 45.7%였다.)

The land area owned by corporations was 7,463 km2, up 59 km2 (0.8%) from a year earlier. By use zone, agricultural areas (2,443 km2) were the most common, and by land category, forests (3,460 km2) were the most frequently owned. By size, the number of corporations was highest in the 1,000–5,000 m2 range (87,000, 23%), followed by 10–50 m2 (72,000, 18.9%) and 100–500 m2 (56,000, 14.8%). ( 법인이 소유한 토지 면적은 7463㎢로 1년 전보다 59㎢(0.8%) 증가했다. 용도지역은 농림지역(2443㎢), 지목은 임야(3460㎢)를 가장 많이 소유했다. 면적 규모별 법인 수는 1천∼5천㎡(8만7천개, 23%), 10∼50㎡(7만2천개, 18.9%), 100∼500㎡(5만6천개, 14.8%) 순이다.)

The land area owned by non-corporate entities, such as clans and religious organizations, was 7,823 km2, similar to a year earlier. By use zone, agricultural areas (4,446 km2) were the most common, and by land category, forests (7,228 km2) were the most frequently owned. By size, the number of non-corporate entities was highest in the 1,000–5,000 m2 range (53,000, 23%), followed by 10,000–50,000 m2 (47,000, 20.7%) and valuing 50 million to 100 million won (34,000, 14.8%). ( 종중, 종교단체 등 비법인의 토지소유 면적은 7823㎢로 1년 전과 유사했다. 용도지역은 농림지역(4446㎢), 지목은 임야(7228㎢)를 가장 많이 소유했다. 면적 규모별 비법인 수는 1천∼5천㎡(5만3천개, 23%), 1만∼5만㎡(4만7천개, 20.7%), 5천만원∼1억원(3만4천개, 14.8%) 순이었다.)

The land ownership statistics are compiled annually based on land (forest) registry data registered by local governments across the country, comprising 39 categories including details by gender, age, region, area, and value for individuals, households, corporations, and non-corporate entities. ( 토지소유현황 통계는 전국 지방정부에서 등록한 토지(임야) 대장 정보를 기초로 매년 작성하며, 개인·가구·법인·비법인이 보유한 토지에 대한 성별·연령별, 지역별, 면적·가액 규모별 현황 등 총 39종으로 구성된다.)

Reporter Lee Ji-hye godot@hani.co.kr ( 이지혜 기자 godot@hani.co.kr)

item.title: SK Hynix Q2 Operating Profit Hits 60.5 Trillion Won... Soaring 6.5 Times Year-on-Year (SK하이닉스 2분기 영업이익 60조5천억원…전년비 6.5배 급증)
item.description:
SK Hynix reported an operating profit of 60.5 trillion won for the second quarter of this year, soaring over six times compared to the same period last year. This marks the largest quarterly profit on record. However, it fell short of the already heightened market expectations. (에스케이(SK)하이닉스의 올해 2분기 영업이익이 60조5천억원으로 전년 동기 대비 6배 넘게 급증했다. 역대 최대 분기 이익이다. 그러나 높아질 대로 높아진 시장 전망치에는 못 미쳤다.)

SK Hynix announced on the 29th that its operating profit for the second quarter (April to June) reached 60.5426 trillion won, up 557.2% from the same period last year. This figure falls slightly below the average securities firm forecast of 63.1532 trillion won, as compiled by financial information provider FnGuide, by a margin of over 2 trillion won. ( 에스케이하이닉스는 지난 2분기(4∼6월) 영업이익이 60조5426억원으로 지난해 같은 기간에 견줘 557.2% 늘었다고 29일 공시했다. 이는 금융정보업체인 에프앤가이드가 집계한 증권사 전망값 평균(63조1532억원)을 2조원 남짓 하회하는 규모다.)

The company's quarterly operating profit previously stood at 7.4405 trillion won in Q1 of last year, 9.2129 trillion won in Q2, 11.3834 trillion won in Q3, 19.1696 trillion won in Q4, and 37.6103 trillion won in Q1 of this year. While operating profit in Q2 of this year increased 1.6 times compared to the previous quarter, it still fell short of market expectations. ( 이 회사의 분기 영업이익은 앞서 지난해 1분기 7조4405억원, 2분기 9조2129억원, 3분기 11조3834억원, 4분기 19조1696억원, 올해 1분기 37조6103억원을 기록한 바 있다. 올해 2분기엔 직전 분기보다 영업이익이 1.6배 증가했으나, 시장 눈높이는 밑돈 셈이다. )

Second-quarter revenue reached 79.3187 trillion won, up 256.8% year-on-year. This also fell short of the average market forecast of 82.5827 trillion won by more than 3 trillion won. ( 2분기 매출액은 79조3187억원으로 전년 동기 대비 256.8% 늘어났다. 이 역시 시장 전망치 평균(82조5827억원)에는 3조원 이상 못 미쳤다.)

The company explained, "The cumulative revenue for the first half of this year (January to June) exceeded 100 trillion won for the first time ever," and added, "We have finalized long-term supply agreement (LTA) negotiations with about 10 customers, including key clients, and are continuing additional discussions with major players in the industry." SK Hynix plans to hold an investor relations (IR) meeting at 9 a.m. today to present its business results and conduct a Q&A session. ( 회사 쪽은 “올해 상반기(1∼6월) 누적 매출이 사상 처음으로 100조원대에 올라섰다”며 “핵심 고객을 포함해 10여개 고객과 장기공급계약(LTA) 협상을 마무리했으며 업계 주요 고객들과 추가 논의도 이어가고 있다”고 설명했다. 에스케이하이닉스는 이날 오전 9시 기업설명회(IR)를 열어 경영 실적 발표 및 질의응답을 진행할 예정이다. )

Reporter Park Jong-oh pjo2@hani.co.kr ( 박종오 기자 pjo2@hani.co.kr)

item.title: KOSPI Rises at Open After Previous Day's Plunge… Up Nearly 2% in Early Trading (코스피 전날 폭락 딛고 ‘상승 출발’…장 초반 2% 오름세)
item.description:
On the morning of the 29th, when SK Hynix announced record-breaking second-quarter earnings, the KOSPI rebounded from the previous day's sharp decline and showed an upward trend. Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix are posting strong gains, lifting the index. (에스케이(SK)하이닉스가 역대 최대 2분기 실적을 발표한 29일 아침 코스피는 전날의 폭락세를 벗어나 상승세를 기록 중이다. 삼성전자, 에스케이하이닉스가 강한 상승세를 보이며 지수를 끌어올리고 있다.)

The KOSPI opened at 6089.11, up 65.45 points (1.09%) from the previous day, and continued its upward momentum, reaching 6185.66 as of 9:10 a.m., a 2.69% increase. Samsung Electronics is up around 5%, while SK Hynix is recording a gain of about 3%. (코스피는 전날보다 65.45(1.09%) 오른 6089.11로 출발해 상승세를 이어가며 9시10분 현재 2.69% 오른 6185.66을 기록 중이다. 삼성전자는 5%대, 에스케이하이닉스는 3%대의 상승률을 기록 중이다.)

The KOSDAQ index also started higher, showing an increase of around 1%. (코스닥 지수도 오름세로 출발해 1%대의 상승률을 나타내고 있다.)

item.title: Hyundai E&C ’s ‘Hillsstate Hoeryong Station Parkview’ offers unprecedented terms of KRW 30 million until move-in (현대건설 ‘힐스테이트 회룡역파크뷰’ 입주까지 3천만원 파격조건 내걸어)
item.description:
KRW 30 million until move-in… ‘Hillsstate Hoeryong Station Parkview’ offers unprecedented terms (입주까지 3천만원… ‘힐스테이트 회룡역파크뷰’ 파격조건 내걸어)

( )

- Fixed down payment of KRW 5 million, balance payment deferral of up to KRW 200 million reduces burden for end-users (- 계약금 500만원 정액제, 잔금 2억 유예 혜택으로 실수요자 부담 낮춰)

- Rising home prices in Seoul’s Nowon, Dobong, Gangbuk districts… Emerges as alternative residential area with Seoul accessibility and price competitiveness (- 서울 노도강 집값 상승… 서울 접근성·가격 경쟁력 갖춘 대체 주거지로 부상)

- Guri, Dongtan, Giheung newly designated as regulated areas… Will the ‘balloon effect’ reappear in non-regulated areas? (- 구리·동탄·기흥 규제지역 신규 지정… 비규제지역 ‘풍선효과’ 재현될까)

- Enhanced product quality shines after move-in… “A great place to live,” earning praise from residents (- 입주 후 더 빛난 상품성… “살기 좋은 아파트” 입주민 호평 이어져)

( )

‘Hillsstate Hoeryong Station Parkview’, located in Howon-dong, Uijeongbu-si, Gyeonggi Province, has announced changes to its contract terms. This measure aims to ease the financial burden on end-users amid the triple crises of high prices, high oil costs, and high interest rates. (경기도 의정부시 호원동에 위치한 ‘힐스테이트 회룡역파크뷰’가 계약조건을 변경한다고 밝혔다. 고물가·고유가·고금리 등 3고 위기 속 실수요자들의 자금 부담을 낮추기 위한 조치다.)

‘Hillsstate Hoeryong Station Parkview’ is situated at 281-21 Howon-dong, Uijeongbu-si, Gyeonggi Province. It is a large complex with 3 basement levels, 33 stories above ground, 12 buildings, exclusive areas of 39 to 84 m², and a total of 1,816 households. Among these, 674 households of the popular mid-to-small sized exclusive areas of 59 and 84 m² are available for general sale. (‘힐스테이트 회룡역파크뷰’는 경기도 의정부시 호원동 281-21번지 일원에 위치하며, 지하 3층~지상 33층, 12개동, 전용면적 39~84㎡, 총 1816가구 규모의 대단지다. 이 중 수요자들의 선호도 높은 중·소형 타입의 전용면적 59·84㎡ 674가구가 일반분양분이다.)

( )

Typically, when selling apartments, the down payment is set at 10% of the sale price, but ‘Hillsstate Hoeryong Station Parkview’ applied a fixed down payment system of KRW 5 million. For the exclusive 84 m² unit, the interim payment is KRW 25 million, requiring only KRW 30 million in initial funds before move-in. (통상 아파트 분양 시 계약금은 분양가의 10%로 책정되는 것이 일반적이나, ‘힐스테이트 회룡역파크뷰’는 계약금 500만원 정액제를 적용했다. 전용 84㎡ 기준 중도금은 2500만원으로, 입주 전까지 필요한 초기 자금이 3000만원에 불과하다.)

( )

Part of the balance payment is offered with an interest-free deferment option, reducing the burden on the buyer to prepare a lump sum. Up to KRW 200 million of the balance can be paid up to 18 months after move-in without incurring separate interest. The balance benefit is provided upon meeting conditions, and contracts are expected to accelerate. (잔금 일부는 무이자 유예 조건을 제공해 계약자가 목돈을 한 번에 마련해야 하는 부담을 낮췄다. 잔금 중 최대 2억원은 입주 후 최대 18개월 뒤에 납부해도 별도의 이자가 발생하지 않는 방식이다. 잔금 혜택은 조건 성립 시 제공되며, 계약에 속도가 붙을 것으로 전망된다.)

( )

The sale price for the exclusive 84 m² unit is set from the late KRW 700 million range to the early KRW 800 million range. Compared to major complexes in Nowon, Dobong, and Gangbuk districts in northeastern Seoul, it is considered competitively priced. According to the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport’s actual transaction price disclosure system, this year’s actual transaction prices for exclusive 84 m² units exceeded KRW 1.4 billion in Nowon-gu, surpassed KRW 1.1 billion in Dobong-gu, and broke KRW 1.2 billion in Gangbuk-gu. (전용 84㎡ 분양가는 7억원 후반대부터 8억원 초반대로 책정됐다. 서울 동북부에 위치한 노원·도봉·강북 주요 단지와 비교해보면 가격 경쟁력을 갖췄다는 평가다. 국토교통부 실거래가 공개시스템에 따르면, 올해 노원구 전용 84㎡ 실거래가는 14억원을 넘었고, 도봉구는 11억원, 강북구는 12억원을 돌파했다.)

( )

‘Hillsstate Hoeryong Station Parkview’ is located approximately 3 km in a straight line from the Seoul border, positioning it as an alternative residential area. The complex is near Hoeryong Station on Subway Line 1 and the Uijeongbu Light Rail. Using these, one can enter Seoul (Dobongsan Station) in just two stops and reach major Seoul business districts like City Hall Station and Gangnam-gu Office Station within about 40 minutes. The GTX-C line (planned) is being promoted at Uijeongbu Station, one stop from Hoeryong Station, which will further improve accessibility to Gangnam in the future. (‘힐스테이트 회룡역파크뷰’는 서울 경계까지 직선거리로 약 3km면 닿을 수 있는 거리에 위치해 대체 주거지 역할을 할 것으로 전망된다. 단지는 인근에 위치한 지하철 1호선·의정부경전철 회룡역 이용 시 두 정거장이면 서울(도봉산역) 진입이 가능하고, 시청역, 강남구청역 등 서울 주요 업무지구까지는 40분대로 도달 가능하다. 회룡역에서 한 정거장인 의정부역에는 GTX-C노선(예정)이 추진되고 있어 향후 강남 접근성은 더욱 좋아질 예정이다.)

( )

It is also noteworthy that Uijeongbu-si, Gyeonggi Province, where the complex is located, is a non-regulated area. On June 30, the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport newly designated Hwaseong-si’s Dongtan-gu, Yongin-si’s Giheung-gu, and Guri-si as speculation-prone zones and adjustment areas. The designation took effect on July 1, and Gyeonggi Province also announced that it would designate these areas as land transaction permit zones starting July 5. (단지가 들어서는 경기도 의정부시가 비규제지역이라는 점도 눈여겨볼 만하다. 국토교통부는 지난 6월 30일 화성시 동탄구와 용인시 기흥구, 구리시를 투기과열지구 및 조정대상지역으로 신규 지정했다. 지정 효력은 7월 1일부터 발생하며, 경기도도 이들 지역을 7월 5일부터 토지거래허가구역으로 지정한다고 밝혔다. )

( )

With this designation, the loan-to-value ratio (LTV) for home-backed loans within speculation-prone zones is limited to 40% for those without a home (including conditional single-home owners), and new loans for home purchase by existing homeowners are prohibited in principle. In adjustment areas, a higher acquisition tax rate for multiple homeowners applies, and measures covering finance and taxation overall are implemented, including heavy capital gains tax and a mandatory two-year residence requirement for single-homeowner tax exemptions. (이번 지정으로 투기과열지구 내 무주택자(처분조건부 1주택자 포함)의 주택담보대출비율(LTV)은 40%로 제한되며, 유주택자의 신규 주택 구입 목적 대출은 원칙적으로 금지된다. 조정대상지역에서는 다주택자 취득세 중과세율이 적용되고, 양도소득세 중과 및 1가구 1주택 비과세 요건 내 2년 거주 의무가 부여되는 등 금융과 세제 전반에 걸친 조치가 시행된다.)

( )

Some predict a ‘balloon effect’ where purchasing demand shifts to adjacent non-regulated areas, similar to the past when Seoul and parts of Gyeonggi Province were tied to regulated zones. Unlike other complexes with reduced loan limits, ‘Hillsstate Hoeryong Station Parkview’ in Uijeongbu-si can apply an LTV of up to 70%, and it is not subject to tax regulations such as acquisition tax and capital gains tax, nor the mandatory residency requirement. (일각에서는 서울과 경기 일부 지역이 규제지역으로 묶였던 과거와 마찬가지로 이번에도 인접 비규제지역으로 매수세가 이동하는 ‘풍선효과’가 나타날 수 있다는 전망이 나온다. 의정부시에 위치한 ‘힐스테이트 회룡역파크뷰’는 대출한도가 축소된 다른 단지들과 달리, 주택담보대출비율(LTV)이 최대 70%까지 적용되며, 취득세, 양도소득세 등 세금 규제와 실거주 의무 역시 적용받지 않기 때문이다. )

‘Hillsstate Hoeryong Station Parkview’ has also been receiving positive reviews since moving-in began in April. It is the first Hillsstate brand apartment by Hyundai E&C in Howon-dong, Uijeongbu-si, applying differentiated product designs. Residents have expressed high satisfaction with features such as abundant landscaping facilities, a large community space, ample parking, and floor noise reduction design. (‘힐스테이트 회룡역파크뷰’는 지난 4월 입주 시작 이후 호평이 이어지고 있는 단지이기도 하다. 현대건설이 의정부시 호원동에 처음 선보인 힐스테이트 브랜드 아파트로, 차별화된 상품설계가 적용돼서다. 입주민들은 풍부한 조경시설과 대규모 커뮤니티, 넓은 주차공간, 층간소음 저감설계 등에 대한 높은 만족도를 나타냈다.)

( )

A sales representative said, “Howon-dong, where the complex is located, has a high proportion of older apartments within Uijeongbu-si, so the differentiated product quality of‘Hillsstate Hoeryong Station Parkview’ stands out even more. With the contract terms change reducing the initial financial burden, along with Seoul accessibility and the advantages of a non-regulated area, we are continuously receiving inquiries from end-users in nearby areas, including Nowon, Dobong, and Gangbuk.” (분양 관계자는 “단지가 위치한 호원동은 의정부시 내에서도 노후 아파트 비율이 높은 지역인 만큼 ‘힐스테이트 회룡역파크뷰’의 차별화된 상품성이 더욱 부각되는 분위기”라며 “계약조건 변경으로 초기 자금 부담을 낮춘 데다, 서울 접근성과 비규제지역의 장점까지 갖춰 노도강을 비롯한 인접 지역 수요자들의 문의가 꾸준히 이어지고 있다”고 말했다.)

‘Hillsstate Hoeryong Station Parkview’ is currently accepting contracts on a first-come, first-served basis. Anyone aged 19 or older can sign a contract regardless of residence area. Multiple homeowners are also eligible to contract, and buyers can choose their desired building and unit number. Immediate move-in is possible upon contract signing. (‘힐스테이트 회룡역파크뷰’는 현재 선착순 계약을 진행 중이다. 만 19세 이상이면 거주 지역과 관계없이 누구나 계약 가능하다. 다주택자도 계약 가능하며, 원하는 동·호수를 직접 선택할 수 있다. 계약 즉시 입주도 가능하다.)

( )

The showroom is located at 314-7 Howon-dong, Uijeongbu-si, Gyeonggi Province. (견본주택은 경기도 의정부시 호원동 314-7번지에 위치한다.)

item.title: KOSPI plunges over 4% intraday, falling to 5700 level… another sell-side circuit breaker triggered (코스피 장중 4%대 급락, 5700선까지 밀려…또 매도 사이드카)
item.description:
On the 29th, when SK Hynix announced its record-breaking second-quarter earnings, the KOSPI fluctuated in the morning session before falling below the 6000 mark. (에스케이(SK)하이닉스가 역대 최대 2분기 실적을 발표한 29일 코스피는 오전 장중 등락을 거듭하다 6000선 아래로 주저앉았다. )

The index opened at 6089.11, up 65.45 points (1.09%) from the previous day, maintained its upward trend, then turned downward and hovered around the 6000 point level. Subsequently, it widened its losses, plunging over 4% to 5727.99 as of 10:55 a.m., triggering a sell-side circuit breaker (temporary halt of program sell orders). (이날 코스피는 전날보다 65.45포인트(1.09%) 오른 6089.11로 출발해 상승세를 이어가다 곧 하락 반전한 뒤 6000포인트를 넘나들었다. 이후 하락폭을 확대하더니 4%대 급락하며 오전 10시55분 현재 5727.99로 떨어지며 매도 사이드카(프로그램 매도호가 일시 효력정지)가 발동됐다.)

Samsung Electronics initially posted a sharp gain of over 5% in early trading, but then reduced its gains and turned negative. SK Hynix started on an upward trend but then showed a sharp decline of over 6%, leading the overall index drop. (삼성전자는 장 초반 5%대에 이르는 큰 폭의 상승률을 기록하다가 상승 폭을 줄이며 마이너스로 돌아섰다. 에스케이하이닉스는 오름세로 출발했다가 6%대에 이르는 큰 폭의 하락세를 보여 전체 지수 하락을 주도하고 있다.)

SK Hynix reported its second-quarter operating profit at 60.5 trillion won, up 557.2% from the same period last year—a record performance—yet it fell short of market expectations (average securities firm forecast compiled by FnGuide at 63.1532 trillion won). The stock price decline is analyzed to have resulted from the lack of significant news during the subsequent earnings briefing. (에스케이하이닉스가 이날 발표한 2분기 영업이익은 60조5천억원으로 지난해 같은 기간에 견줘 557.2% 늘어난 역대급 실적임에도 시장 전망치(에프앤가이드 집계 증권사 전망값 평균 63조1532억원)에는 미치지 못하는 것으로 평가됐다. 실적 발표 뒤 이어진 설명회에서도 의미있는 소식이 전해지지 않아 주가 하락으로 이어진 것으로 분석된다.)

The KOSDAQ index also started on an upward trend but reversed to a decline, recording 673.72, down 4.55%, at the same time. (이날 코스닥 지수도 오름세로 출발했다가 하락 반전해 같은 시각 4.55% 떨어진 673.72를 기록했다.)

item.title: "Expanding Subway on Roads"… 1.6 Trillion Won Investment in Local BRT to Bridge Transportation Gaps (“도로 위 지하철 확대”…지방 BRT에 1조6천억 투자, 교통격차 해소)
item.description:
The government has decided to expand investment in the Bus Rapid Transit (BRT) system, often described as a "subway on roads," in major provincial cities by 2030. BRT is a bus system that integrates railway systems into bus operations to enhance punctuality and travel speed. The aim is to reduce transportation disparities between the Seoul metropolitan area and provincial regions, and to shift from car-centered inter-regional travel to public transit-focused mobility. (정부가 2030년까지 지방대도시권에 ‘도로 위 지하철’ 간선급행버스체계(BRT) 투자를 확대하기로 했다. 비알티란 버스운행에 철도시스템을 접목해 정시성, 통행속도를 끌어올린 버스체계다. 수도권과 지방의 교통 격차를 줄이고, 승용차 중심의 지역 간 이동을 대중교통 중심으로 전환한다는 취지다.)

On the 29th, the Metropolitan Transport Commission under the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport confirmed and announced the '2nd Comprehensive Plan for the Bus Rapid Transit System (2026–2030),' which outlines BRT policy directions for the next five years. The commission releases a comprehensive plan every five years, detailing BRT construction plans and implementation tasks. (국토교통부 대도시권광역교통위원회는 29일 향후 5년의 비알티 정책 방향을 담은 ‘제2차 간선급행버스체계 종합계획(2026~2030)’을 확정·고시했다. 대광위는 5년 단위로 비알티 건설 계획과 추진 과제를 담아 종합계획을 발표한다.)

According to the comprehensive plan, the government will focus on expanding BRT investment primarily in major provincial cities to alleviate inter-regional transportation gaps. By 2030, a total project cost of 1.6 trillion won, including 530 billion won in national funds, will be invested to establish 38 BRT routes nationwide. Notably, 77% (407.6 billion won) of the national funds will be allocated to provincial areas. The plan aims to connect BRT routes to airports, railway stations, and bus terminals, positioning them as key hubs linking other transportation modes, and enhancing convenience for inter-city travel by connecting adjacent cities. Among the 38 routes, 15 are new projects, including △Jinhae, South Gyeongsang–Gadeokdo New Airport, Busan △Osong Station, North Chungcheong–Sejong National Assembly △Incheon 3rd Bridge–Unseo Station. (종합계획을 보면, 정부는 지방 대도시권 중심으로 비알티 투자를 확대해 지역 간 교통 격차를 완화하는 데 중점을 두기로 했다. 2030년까지 총사업비 1조6천억원, 국비 5300억원을 투입해 전국 38개 비알티 노선을 구축하는데, 국비 77%(4076억원)를 지방권에 투자한다는 계획이다. 이를 통해 비알티 노선을 공항·철도역·버스터미널에 닿게 해 다른 교통수단과 연결하는 핵심축으로 키우고, 인접 도시와 연결해 광역 간 이동 편의성을 높인다는 구상이다. △경남 진해~부산 가덕도신공항 △충북 오송역~세종 국회의사당 △인천 제3연륙교~운서역 등 38개 노선 중 15개가 신규사업으로 추진된다.)

Additionally, the commission plans to double the length of exclusive BRT lanes nationwide (from 351 km to 707 km) and increase bus travel speed by 20%, from 21 km/h to 25 km/h. The plan also includes minimizing height differences between platforms and vehicles, expanding low-floor buses to enhance mobility for transportation-disadvantaged groups, and increasing the share of eco-friendly hydrogen and electric buses to over 50%. (이 밖에도 대광위는 전국 비알티 전용 주행로를 2배 확충(351㎞→707㎞)하고, 버스 통행 속도를 21㎞/h에서 25㎞/h로 20% 높이기로 했다. 승강장과 차량 간 단차를 최소화하고 저상버스를 확대하는 등 교통약자 이동권 강화, 친환경 수소·전기버스 비중 50% 이상 확대도 이번 계획에 담겼다.)

Kim Yong-seok, chairman of the Metropolitan Transport Commission, stated, "The 2nd Comprehensive BRT Plan goes beyond simply expanding bus infrastructure; it is a mid-to-long-term blueprint to foster BRT as a key axis of the metropolitan transport network connecting the five poles and three special zones." He added, "We will upgrade inter-regional connections and transfer systems at major hubs to create an environment where the public can travel faster and more conveniently." (김용석 대광위원장은 “제2차 비알티 종합계획은 단순한 버스 인프라 확충을 넘어 5극3특을 연결하는 광역교통망의 핵심축으로 비알티를 육성하는 중장기 청사진”이라며 “광역권 간 연계와 주요 거점과의 환승 체계를 고도화해 국민이 더욱 빠르고 편리하게 이동할 수 있는 환경을 조성하겠다”고 말했다.)

Reporter Shin Min-jeong shin@hani.co.kr (신민정 기자 shin@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Commercial banks' 'real estate delinquency rate' hits highest in 10 years… Impact of interest rates and industry downturn (시중은행 ‘부동산업 연체율’ 10년 만에 최고…금리·업종 침체 영향)
item.description:
Due to high interest rates and the ongoing slump in the commercial real estate market, IBK Industrial Bank's delinquency rate for real estate-related industries has reached its highest level in 14 years. This rate has also risen to a 10-year high at major commercial banks. (고금리와 상업용 부동산 경기 침체가 이어지면서 아이비케이(IBK)기업은행의 부동산 관련 업종 연체율이 14년 만에 최고치를 기록했다. 주요 시중은행에서도 이 연체율이 10년래 최고 수준으로 올랐다.)

According to Industrial Bank on the 29th, the delinquency rate for small and medium-sized real estate and rental businesses (based on overdue principal and interest for more than one month) stood at 1.54% at the end of the second quarter of this year. This is the highest in about 14 years since the third quarter of 2012 (2.02%). The delinquency rate rose by 0.26 percentage points from the end of the previous quarter. The year-on-year increase was 0.90 percentage points, the largest since the first quarter of 2011. Industrial Bank stated, "Although the recent downturn in the real estate market has impacted related industries, we do not view it as a level that will spread to widespread concern across the sector." (29일 기업은행에 따르면, 올해 2분기 말 중소 부동산업 및 임대업 연체율(1개월 이상 원리금 연체 기준)은 1.54%로 집계됐다. 2012년 3분기(2.02%) 이후 약 14년 만에 가장 높다. 연체율은 전분기 말보다 0.26%포인트 올랐다. 작년 동기 대비 상승폭은 0.90%포인트로 2011년 1분기 이후 가장 컸다. 기업은행은 “최근 부동산 경기 악화로 관련 업종에 영향이 있지만 업종 전반에 대한 경계로 번질 수준은 아닌 것으로 보고 있다”고 말했다.)

Delinquency rates in other sectors are also high. The delinquency rate for small and medium-sized wholesale and retail businesses was 1.11%, up 0.04 percentage points from the end of the first quarter (1.07%), marking the highest since data compilation began in 2011. The construction industry delinquency rate stood at 1.64% at the end of the first quarter of this year and 1.32% at the end of the second quarter, still hovering around 1%. (다른 업종 연체율도 높다. 중소 도소매업 연체율은 1.11%로 1분기 말(1.07%)보다 0.04%포인트 올라 2011년 자료 작성 이래 가장 높았다. 건설업 연체율은 올해 1분기 말 1.64%, 2분기 말 1.32% 등으로 여전히 1%대를 보인다.)

At other commercial banks, the real estate delinquency rate continues to rise. Shinhan Bank's delinquency rate for real estate and rental businesses at the end of the second quarter was 0.42%, the highest since sector-specific tracking began in the first quarter of 2021. After jumping from 0.21% at the end of last year to 0.35% at the end of the first quarter of this year, it climbed further in the second quarter. Woori Bank's delinquency rate at the end of the second quarter was 0.62%, the highest in 10 years since the first quarter of 2016 (1.57%). Hana Bank's delinquency rate at the end of the second quarter (0.57%) was also the highest in 10 years since the end of the second quarter of 2016 (0.58%). A commercial bank official said, "As self-employed business closures increase, rental income from commercial properties declines, and with the commercial real estate market sluggish, asset sales have become difficult. Amid high interest rates, delinquency rates for rental operators unable to handle increased loan interest are rising." (다른 시중은행에서도 부동산업 연체율은 상승세를 지속하고 있다. 신한은행의 2분기 말 부동산업 및 임대업 연체율은 0.42%로, 업종별 집계를 시작한 2021년 1분기 이래 가장 높았다. 작년 말 0.21%에서 올해 1분기 말 0.35%로 뛴 뒤 2분기 들어 더 올랐다. 우리은행의 2분기 말 연체율은 0.62%로 2016년 1분기(1.57%) 이후 10년 만에 가장 높았다. 하나은행의 2분기 말 연체율(0.57%)도 2016년 2분기 말(0.58%) 이후 10년 만에 가장 높은 수준이다. 시중은행 관계자는 “자영업자 폐업이 늘면서 상가 임대 수입이 감소하고, 상업용 부동산 시장 침체로 자산 매각도 어려워진 가운데 고금리로 늘어난 대출 이자를 감당하지 못하는 임대 사업자 연체율이 상승하고 있다”고 말했다.)

Previously, in a financial stability report submitted to the National Assembly last month, the Bank of Korea classified the real estate industry as a 'cautionary sector' with sluggish growth over the past two to three years, assessing that "financial institutions' exposure to cautionary sectors such as wholesale/retail and real estate is significant, and delinquency rates are higher than the overall industry average, requiring special attention to asset soundness management." (앞서 한국은행은 지난달 국회에 제출한 금융안정보고서에서 부동산업을 최근 2∼3년간 성장성이 부진한 ‘주의 업종’으로 분류하고 “도소매 및 부동산 등 주의 업종에 대한 금융기관의 익스포저(위험노출액)가 크고 연체율도 전체 업종 평균보다 높은 수준이어서 각별한 자산건전성 관리가 요구된다”고 평가했다.)

Jo Gye-wan, Senior Reporter kyewan@hani.co.kr (조계완 선임기자 kyewan@hani.co.kr)

item.title: "Social Solidarity Economy Basic Law Must Be Submitted to the National Assembly Plenary Session on the 30th and Processed" (“사회연대경제기본법, 30일 국회 본회의 상정해 처리해야”)
item.description:
Social solidarity economy groups held a press conference on the 28th in front of the main gate of the National Assembly in Yeongdeungpo-gu, Seoul, urging the swift processing of the Social Solidarity Economy Basic Law in the National Assembly. Groups such as the Korea Social Solidarity Economy, the National Network for Social Economy Revitalization, the Social Finance Forum, and the National Council of Local Governments for Social Solidarity Economy demanded at the press conference that the basic law be submitted to the plenary session scheduled for the 30th and passed without fail. (사회연대경제 단체들이 28일 서울 영등포구 국회 정문 앞에서 기자회견을 열어 ‘사회연대경제기본법’의 조속한 국회 처리를 촉구했다. 한국사회연대경제, 사회적경제활성화전국네트워크, 사회적금융포럼, 전국 사회연대경제 지방정부협의회 등은 이날 회견에서 오는 30일 열리는 국회 본회의에 기본법을 상정해 반드시 통과시켜야 한다고 요구했다.)

Yoo Yoo-mi, executive director of the social cooperative "Together with Us" under the National Federation of Residents' Cooperatives, emphasized the need for the basic law's enactment in an on-site speech, stating, "On the pillars built by residents themselves through their own efforts, enacting the Social Solidarity Economy Basic Law is finally putting a roof on top." (유유미 전국주민협동연합회 사회적협동조합 우리함께 상임이사는 현장 발언에서 “주민들이 스스로 쌓아 올린 기둥 위에, 사회연대경제기본법 제정은 마침내 지붕을 얹는 일”이라며 기본법 제정의 필요성을 강조했다.)

The social solidarity economy has played a role in filling gaps in local communities, such as providing housing and financial services for vulnerable groups that the market struggles to address, as well as care services and local economic circulation. However, entities within the social solidarity economy—such as social enterprises, village enterprises, and cooperatives—have operated their businesses scattered as individual organizations, and related policies have repeatedly expanded and contracted in line with government stances. The field's opinion was that a close cooperation system, backed by legal support, is necessary to unite these fragmented organizations and create a sustainable social solidarity economy ecosystem. (사회연대경제는 시장이 해결하기 어려운 취약계층을 위한 주거·금융 서비스, 돌봄과 지역경제순환 등 지역 현장의 사각지대를 보완하는 역할을 해왔다. 하지만 사회적기업, 마을기업, 협동조합 등 사회연대경제 주체들은 개별조직 단위로 흩어져 사업을 운영해왔고, 관련 정책도 정부 기조에 따라 확대와 위축을 반복해왔다. 분절된 조직을 아우르고 지속 가능한 사회연대경제 생태계를 만들려면 법적인 뒷받침 속에 긴밀한 협력체계가 이뤄져야 한다는 게 현장의 의견이었다.)

However, the enactment of the Social Solidarity Economy Basic Law, which would foster such an environment, has been slow. The basic law was first proposed in 2014 but has since been repeatedly discarded and re-proposed in the National Assembly over 13 years. It was re-proposed in the current 22nd National Assembly and passed successively through the National Assembly's Public Administration and Security Committee (March 26) and the Legislation and Judiciary Committee (April 22), but due to a lack of cooperation from the People Power Party, it has not been submitted to the plenary session for three months, failing to clear the final hurdle. Groups participating in the press conference expressed concern that if the enactment of the basic law continues to be delayed, there will be no legal basis to reorganize the organizations and budgets dedicated to the social solidarity economy, leading to gaps and confusion in local communities. (하지만 이런 환경을 조성할 사회연대경제기본법 제정은 더디기만 했다. 기본법은 2014년 처음 발의됐으나 이후 13년간 국회에서 폐기와 발의를 반복했다. 이번 22대 국회에서 다시 발의돼 국회 행정안전위원회(3월26일)와 법제사법위원회(4월22일)를 잇달아 통과했지만, 국민의힘이 협조하지 않아 3개월째 본회의에 상정되지 않은 채 마지막 문턱을 넘지 못하고 있다. 회견에 나선 단체들은 기본법 제정이 계속 미뤄지면 사회연대경제 전담조직과 예산을 정비할 법적 근거가 없어, 지역 현장에서 공백과 혼선이 이어질 것이라고 우려했다.)

Meanwhile, on that day, the Democratic Party's Social Solidarity Economy Legislation Promotion Group (led by Rep. Kim Young-bae) and the National Social Economy Committee (led by Rep. Bok Ki-wang) also held a press conference at the National Assembly's communication center, requesting the opposition's cooperation for the passage of the Social Solidarity Economy Basic Law. Rep. Kim Young-bae said, "Since the UN has also adopted a resolution on revitalizing the social solidarity economy, calling for institutional support from member states, we must end the 13-year wait and pass the Social Solidarity Economy Basic Law at the plenary session on July 30, laying a historical stepping stone for solidarity and cooperative governance." (한편 이날 더불어민주당 사회연대경제입법추진단(단장 김영배 의원)과 전국사회적경제위원회(위원장 복기왕 의원)도 국회 소통관에서 기자회견을 열어 사회연대경제기본법 통과를 위한 야당의 협조를 당부했다. 김영배 의원은 “유엔도 사회연대경제 활성화 결의안을 채택해 회원국의 제도적 지원을 주문한 만큼 7월30일 본회의에서 13년의 기다림을 끝내고 사회연대경제기본법을 통과시켜 연대와 협치의 역사적 디딤돌을 놓아야 한다”고 말했다.)

Article and photo by Kim Soo-young, Senior Researcher at the Hankyoreh Economic and Social Research Institute sy26@hani.co.kr (글·사진 김수영 한겨레경제사회연구원 선임연구원 sy26@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Shin Ramyun tops in Seoul popularity, but Yangcheon and Yongsan’s favorite is Chapagetti (신라면, 서울서 인기 1위지만 양천·용산 ‘최애’는 짜파게티)
item.description:
Among Nongshim ramyun products, Shin Ramyun was the best-selling item in Seoul, but the "favorite ramyun" varied by neighborhood. According to Nongshim’s analysis of first-half sales data by Seoul district, Shin Ramyun maintained its unchallenged top spot, but in some areas, Chapagetti and Shin Ramyun Gold outperformed Shin Ramyun. (농심 라면 가운데 서울에서 가장 많이 팔린 제품은 신라면이었지만, 동네별 ‘최애 라면’은 달랐다. 농심이 올해 상반기 서울 자치구별 판매 데이터를 분석해보니, 신라면은 부동의 1위를 기록했지만 일부 지역에선 짜파게티와 신라면 골드가 신라면을 제치고 강세를 보인 것으로 나타났다.)

The "2026 Seoul Nongshim Ramyun Popularity Map" released by Nongshim on the 29th showed that Shin Ramyun was the company’s most sold product in Seoul. Shin Ramyun ranked first in 15 out of 22 districts with large supermarkets, displaying the highest preference. It was followed by Chapagetti, Spicy Neoguri, Shin Ramyun Gold, Ansungtangmyun, Yukgaejang Bowl Noodles, and Baehongdong Bibim Men. Nongshim analyzed sales data from large supermarkets and corporate-type supermarkets (SSM) in 25 Seoul districts for the first half of this year. <<> A notable finding in this analysis was that in six districts—Yangcheon, Nowon, Seongbuk, Seongdong, Yongsan, and Gwangjin—Chapagetti surpassed Shin Ramyun to become the top seller in large supermarkets. Yangcheon and Nowon districts have a high proportion of family households centered around large apartment complexes, while Seongbuk, Seongdong, Yongsan, and Gwangjin districts have a relatively high proportion of the 2030 generation due to dense universities, business districts, and commercial facilities. Nongshim analyzed that in areas with many family customers, Chapagetti is chosen as a weekend meal or specialty, while in areas with many young people, the "modisumer" (consumers who deviate from standard product usage to create new methods according to personal preferences) consumption trend, combining various ingredients, is reflected in Chapagetti sales. <<> A unique consumption pattern was also identified in Jung-gu. In this district, Shin Ramyun’s global-targeting products, "Shin Ramyun Gold" and "Shin Ramyun Tumba," ranked first and second, respectively. Notably, "Shin Ramyun Tumba" did not make it into the top 10 for overall Seoul sales, but it ranked second in Jung-gu, showing a clear difference from other districts. This is interpreted as increased sales due to foreign tourists visiting Myeongdong, Namdaemun, Dongdaemun, and Seoul Station purchasing it as a K-food souvenir. <<> Meanwhile, unlike large supermarkets where the top product varied by district, corporate-type supermarkets showed consistent results. In all 25 districts of Seoul, Shin Ramyun ranked first in sales among Nongshim ramyun products in corporate-type supermarkets. <<> A Nongshim official said, "Through sales data from Seoul’s 25 districts, we confirmed that consumers’ ramyun choices vary depending on the region’s population, commercial districts, and distribution channels," adding, "We plan to continue offering options tailored to consumers’ lifestyles through various products and brands, expanding our touchpoints with consumers." <<> Reporter Seo Hyemi ham@hani.co.kr (농심이 29일 발표한 ‘2026 서울 농심 라면 인기지도’를 보면, 서울에서 가장 많이 팔린 이 기업 제품은 신라면이었다. 신라면은 서울 대형마트가 있는 22개 자치구 가운데 15개 자치구에서 판매 1위를 차지하며 가장 높은 선호도를 보였다. 이어 짜파게티, 얼큰한 너구리, 신라면 골드, 안성탕면, 육개장사발면, 배홍동비빔면 등이 뒤를 이었다. 농심은 올해 상반기 서울시 25개 자치구 대형마트와 기업형슈퍼마켓(SSM)의 농심 라면 판매 데이터를 분석했다.)

item.title: Deputy PM Koo Yun-cheol: "Virtual Assets Will Be Taxed as Planned Starting Next Year... We Will Supplement Areas That Need Improvement" (구윤철 “가상자산, 예정대로 내년부터 과세…필요한 부분 보완”)
item.description:
Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Economy and Finance Koo Yun-cheol stated that virtual assets will be taxed starting next year. (구윤철 부총리 겸 재정경제부 장관이 내년부터 가상자산에 대해 과세한다는 방침을 밝혔다.)

Deputy Minister Koo made this response on the 29th during a plenary session of the National Assembly's Strategy and Finance Committee, after Representative Kim Sang-hoon of the People Power Party pointed out the need to extend the deferral of virtual asset taxation. Deputy Minister Koo said, "Virtual assets are currently under a tax deferral until the end of this year," adding, "We plan to implement the tax starting next year and, while doing so, proceed with a supplementary approach for any necessary areas." (구 부총리는 29일 국회 재정경제기획위원회 전체회의에서 김상훈 국민의힘 의원이 가상자산 과세 유예 연장 필요성을 지적하자 이처럼 답했다. 구 부총리는 “가상자산에 대해서는 금년 말까지 과세 유예 중”이라며 “내년에 시행해 보면서 필요한 부분이 있으면 보완하는 방향으로 추진하겠다”고 말했다.)

Representative Kim noted that in countries like the United States and Japan, virtual assets are treated as capital gains, allowing for loss deductions, but in South Korea, this is not the case, and argued that this needs review. Deputy Minister Koo responded, "Regarding the issue of loss carryforwards, even stock investments do not allow carryforwards," adding, "Since virtual assets are classified as other income and there are some benefits provided, we will proceed with a supplementary approach after the tax is implemented if necessary." (김 의원은 미국·일본 등에선 가상자산을 자본이득으로 간주해 손실금 결손공제가 되는데, 국내는 그렇지 않다며 검토해야 한다고 지적했다. 구 부총리는 “이월공제 문제는 주식투자도 이월이 안 되고 있다”며 “기타소득으로 분류하면서 혜택을 주는 부분도 있기 때문에, 과세가 시행되고 나서 필요하다면 보완하는 방향으로 추진하겠다”고 답했다.)

Starting January 1st next year, if income from the transfer of virtual assets exceeds 2.5 million won, it will be classified as other income and taxed separately at a rate of 22% (including local taxes). The taxation of virtual assets was introduced through an amendment to the Income Tax Act in 2020, but its implementation has been delayed three times due to insufficient investor protection measures and tax infrastructure. (내년 1월1일부터 가상자산 양도 소득이 250만원을 넘길 경우, 기타소득으로 분류해 22%(지방세 포함)로 분리과세한다. 가상자산 과세는 2020년 소득세법 개정으로 도입됐지만, 투자자 보호 장치와 과세 인프라가 미비하다는 이유로 시행 시기가 세 차례 연기됐다.)

Reporter Park Soo-ji suji@hani.co.kr (박수지 기자 suji@hani.co.kr)

item.title: May births hit 23,160, highest in 7 years... growth rate of 13.6% highest ever (5월 출생아 2만3160명, 7년 만에 가장 많아…증가율 13.6% 역대 최고)
item.description:
The number of births in May exceeded 23,000, recording the highest level in seven years. The growth rate of births in May also reached an all-time high. (5월 출생아 수가 2만3천명을 넘기며 7년 만에 가장 많은 수준으로 집계됐다. 5월 기준 출생아 증가율도 역대 가장 높았다.)

According to the National Statistics Office's 'May Population Trends' released on the 29th, the number of births in May (preliminary) stood at 23,160, an increase of 2,781 (13.6%) from a year earlier. The number of births in May was the highest in seven years since 2019, and the growth rate was the highest since the compilation of related statistics began in 1981. On a cumulative basis from January to May this year, 122,694 babies were born, up 16,166 (15.2%) from 106,528 in the same period last year. Both the increase in number and the growth rate are record highs. ( 29일 국가데이터처의 ‘5월 인구동향’을 보면, 5월 출생아 수(잠정)는 2만3160명으로 1년 전보다 2781명(13.6%) 늘었다. 5월 기준 출생아 수는 2019년 이후 7년 만에 가장 많았고, 증가율은 1981년 관련 통계 집계 이래 가장 높았다. 올해 1∼5월 누계 기준으로는 12만2694명이 태어나 전년 동기간(10만6528명) 대비 1만6166명(15.2%) 증가했다. 증가 폭과 증가율 모두 역대 최고치다.)

The total fertility rate (the average number of children a woman is expected to have in her lifetime) was 0.85 in May, up 0.10 from a year earlier. From January to April this year, the total fertility rate exceeded 0.9 for four consecutive months. If this trend continues, the annual total fertility rate for this year is expected to surpass last year's 0.80. ( 합계출산율(여성 1명이 평생 낳을 것으로 예상되는 평균 출생아 수)은 5월 기준 0.85명으로, 1년 전보다 0.10명 증가했다. 올해 1∼4월에는 합계출산율이 넉 달 연속 0.9명을 넘겼다. 이런 추세가 이어진다면 올해 연간 합계출산율은 지난해(0.80명)를 웃돌 것으로 보인다.)

The increase in the fertility rate was particularly notable among women in their 30s, the main childbearing age group. Looking at the 'age-specific fertility rate for mothers' in May (number of births per 1,000 women of that age), it was 78 for those aged 30-34, up 8.3 from the same period last year. For those aged 35-39, it was 58, an increase of 9.9. ( 주 출산 연령대인 30대에서 출산율 증가세가 두드러졌다. 5월 ‘모의 연령별 출산율’(해당 연령 여성인구 1천명당 출생아 수)을 보면, 30~34살은 78명으로 지난해 같은 기간보다 8.3명 늘었다. 35~39살도 58명으로 9.9명 증가했다. )

The number of marriages in May turned to a decline due to factors such as Labor Day being newly designated as a public holiday. The number of marriages in May was 20,368, down 1,392 (-6.4%) from the same month last year. Park Hyeon-jeong, head of the Population Trends Division at the Statistics Office, explained, "The decline in the number of marriages in May appears to be due to the decrease in reporting days caused by the holiday. When calculated considering the reporting days, the number of marriages actually increased slightly, and the overall upward trend is being maintained." ( 5월 혼인 건수는 노동절이 공휴일로 새로 지정된 영향 등으로 감소 전환했다. 5월 혼인 건수는 2만368건으로 전년 동월 대비 1392건(-6.4%) 줄었다. 박현정 데이터처 인구동향과장은 “5월 혼인 건수 감소는 연휴에 따른 신고일 감소 영향으로 보인다”며 “신고일수를 감안해 계산해보면 오히려 혼인 건수가 소폭 증가해, 전반적인 증가세는 유지되고 있다”고 설명했다. )
